description: District Wise Electrification through Solar Energy KPK is a dataset listed in Open Data Pakistan portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by National Center in Big Data and Cloud Computing (NCBC). District wise number of villages electrified through solar energy in KP from 2016 to 2019. The file contains the following information: 1 Districts 2 Year 3 Number of Villages 4 Number of Houses 5 Energy Generation per Year. Coverage: Pakistan. The portal files it under the publisher National Center in Big Data and Cloud Computing (NCBC). Its tags are KPK, electricity, solar energy. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2021-04-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-pk-od-portal.
